scientific_integrity: Originating model and its global convergence theorem credited. New claim is the sharp model-specific universal decay constant obtained by center-manifold and averaging analysis. Finite integrations supplement but do not prove the long-time limit.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic strictly positive four-type matching Lotka–Volterra flow with neutral competition; not a stochastic convergence or uniform finite-population time theorem. Exact type symmetry relaxes exponentially; all other positive initial conditions have algebraic imbalance. Independent assessment remains outstanding.
title: Sharp algebraic damping in a symmetric matching-type predator–prey system
